verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.blaxel.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of Blaxel's documentation. The docs are also served as .md pages (e.g., Overview.md), and Blaxel ships an installable agent skill plus an open-source migration skill that give agents product knowledge. missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt completeness or depth (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant) and independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
